component.name: Dynamic Island
Dynamický ostrov
component.summary: Live activities over the COSMIC panel

description.p: A Dynamic Island for the COSMIC desktop. It is a panel applet that you can put anywhere in a panel; it shows the date, the time and what is playing. Point at it and it opens into:

ul.li: a home page with a greeting, CPU, graphics, network, memory, disks, battery and a small player,
a shelf that holds files, text and images, can keep a history of what you copy, and sends files to your devices over LocalSend or KDE Connect,
a calendar with the events of Google Calendar, where you can add new ones,
a to-do list that can sync with Google Tasks.

description.p: It follows your COSMIC theme: font, accent, transparency, frosted glass and corner radius. A mode without animations is in the settings.

Dynamický ostrov pro desktop COSMIC. Sedí přes horní panel a ukazuje datum, čas a co hraje. Po najetí myší se rozbalí na přehled systému, ovládání přehrávače s texty písní, přihrádku souborů, kalendář a úkoly synchronizované s Google Tasks.

screenshot.caption: The home page: CPU, network, memory, disks and a small player
The compact island over the panel while music plays

description.p: The island is the panel applet now, so it can sit anywhere in any panel. Adds Google Calendar events, a clipboard history, a new home page and lyrics page, and a mode without animations.
